scope: Public provenance for the TEI specification guide.

externalReferencePolicy.scope: Public knowledge on business-system design, model-driven and metadata-driven development, executable specifications, multi-target applications, and related engineering topics may be consulted when useful.
externalReferencePolicy.independence: External references are sources of design questions and inspiration, not semantic authority, compatibility commitments, or project lineage.
externalReferencePolicy.decisionBasis: TEI decisions are documented through TEI Requirements, Architecture, Reference results, ADRs, implementation, and Evidence.
externalReferencePolicy.reuse: Third-party material is used in accordance with its applicable publication and reuse terms.
